PokeWallClash terrain artwork

Terrain tile artwork: Pokemon Emerald and Pokemon FireRed, sourced from the pret/pokeemerald and pret/pokefirered decompilation projects.
Original artwork belongs to Nintendo, Game Freak, and The Pokemon Company. This is an unofficial noncommercial fan project.

Repository links:
https://github.com/pret/pokeemerald
https://github.com/pret/pokefirered

Source URLs, commits, and SHA-256 hashes are preserved in sources.json, along with hashes for the five packaged terrain images. The terrain atlases preserve source metatile references, palette indices, layer order, and flips; transparent palette index zero is preserved. PokeWallClash composes these tiles into route scenery.
